intentAndPurpose.intent: Toggle button with a persistent selected state. The unselected state is always a muted ghost; `attention` (high/medium/low) drives the selected-state prominence (bold/subtle/ghost-with-border). Supports icon `start`/`end` slots, `contained` (pill container vs inline text/icon), `condensed`, `fullWidth`, `disabled`, and `loading` (busy) states. Controlled via `selected`/`onSelectedChange` or uncontrolled via `defaultSelected` (defaults to true).

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state (the toggle pressed state).

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected state (web parity: defaults to true).

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires with the next boolean selected state.

props.name: value
props.description: Value for a toggle group (parity — not wired to a native group yet).

props.name: attention
props.description: Prominence of the SELECTED state: high→bold fill, medium→subtle fill, low→ghost with accent border. Unselected is always muted ghost.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent role. Explicit non-'auto' wins; otherwise inherits the nearest <Surface appearance>, falling back to 'primary'.

props.name: contained
props.description: true → pill container with background/border/padding; false → inline text/icon only (condensed and fullWidth do not apply).

props.name: condensed
props.description: Reduced height + horizontal padding. Only when `contained`.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill container width. Only when `contained`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables interaction and shows reduced opacity; marks the control busy.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Native press callback — fired alongside the selected-state change.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label override — children text is visible so this is optional.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Describes the result of toggling (React Native).

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: [error] Don't paint directly. Use `appearance` (role) + `variant`/`mode` and wrap in <Surface mode>; the brand cascade picks the right fill.

props.name: style
props.description: Layout style only. attention + appearance + the parent <Surface> drive bg / text — do not paint here. — [warn] SelectableButton colour is surface-resolved from `attention` + `appearance`. Don't set backgroundColor; wrap in <Surface> and it adapts automatically.
